newsitem.title: USA: Columbia/HCA officer to appear in Nashville court.
newsitem.headline: Columbia/HCA officer to appear in Nashville court.

text.p: A third Columbia/HCA Healthcare Corp executive, Robert Whiteside, is expected to appear Wednesday before a federal magistrate to face charges of conspiracy and fraud, according to an FBI agent here.
Whiteside is director of reimbursemnet at Columbia/HCA's headaquarters here.
Derek McGraw, special agent for the FBI in Nashville, said Whiteside will be fingerprinted and processed and then will appear before one of two federal magistrates in Nashville.

Earlier today, a federal grand jury in Florida indicted three Columbia/HCA executives on five counts alleging conspirary to submit false cost reports under U.S. health care programs, Medicare fraud and making false statements.

In addition to Whiteside, Jay Jarrell, chief executive of Columbia's southwest Florida division, and Michael Neeb, chief financial officer of Columbia's northern Florida division, were indicted, the Justice Department said.
Each defendant faces up to 25 years in prison and fines up to $1.25 million if convicted.
